 The Memphis Grizzlies travel to Golden 1 Center on Sunday, October 25, to face the Sacramento Kings in an early-season Western Conference matchup.

 How to Watch Grizzlies vs Kings
 When: Sunday, October 25, 2026
 Time: 9:00 PM ET
 TV Channel: NBC Sports California
 Live Stream: Fubo ( try for free )
 Memphis has opened the 2026-27 NBA season with consecutive victories, defeating the Utah Jazz 123-103 before earning a hard-fought 111-108 road win over the Golden State Warriors on Friday. The Grizzlies are looking to establish a new identity following the departure of Ja Morant, with Ty Jerome, Jerami Grant and GG Jackson II among the players helping lead the team’s revamped roster. Memphis has shown encouraging signs on both ends of the floor and will look to extend its winning streak to three games.
 Sacramento enters Sunday’s contest searching for its first victory after opening the season with losses to the Los Angeles Clippers and Portland Trail Blazers. The Kings surrendered 121 points to the Clippers before falling 128-120 to Portland on Friday, making defensive improvement a priority heading into this matchup. Sacramento will look to take advantage of its home court and get its offense rolling, but a Memphis team playing with confidence presents a difficult challenge. With the Grizzlies looking to remain undefeated and the Kings hoping to avoid an 0-3 start, both teams have plenty to play for on Sunday.
